integrity: The infinite statement is proved symbolically; the accompanying finite script is only a regression check.
The generic \(x(1-x)\) symmetry is credited to prior work; the claimed contribution is specifically the no-loss symmetry of the 2026 divisibility-aware lower functional.
scientific_limitations: The result is a structural reduction for the lower-certificate optimization; it does not improve the published numerical lower bound by itself.

The equality of optimized values is for a fixed reflection-closed finite library. Passing from an arbitrary library to its reflection closure cannot weaken, but may improve, the library-specific optimum.
No claim is made that any finite library is globally optimal for the integer Chebyshev constant.
title: Reflection reduction for divisibility-aware integer Chebyshev lower certificates
